Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to link a card that doesn't have ?

Card Q&A.a: This effect prevents all of your opponent's Digimon from suspending, except their highest play cost Digimon. For example, if your opponent has 1 play cost 5 Digimon and 1 play cost 6 Digimon, the play cost 5 Digimon can't suspend.
Card Q&A.q: What does "other than their highest play cost Digimon, none of your opponent's Digimon can suspend until their turn ends" in this card's [All Turns] effect mean, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can suspend. Your opponent's Digimon with the highest play cost isn't affected by this effect.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent only has 1 play cost 5 Digimon. If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect, can my opponent's Digimon suspend?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, either can be suspended. Your opponent's Digimon with the highest play cost isn't affected by this effect.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has 2 play cost 5 Digimon. If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect, can either of those 2 Digimon suspend?

Card Q&A.a: No, it can't suspend. This effect prevents all of your opponent's Digimon from suspending, except their highest play cost Digimon. If a Digimon is later played and becomes the one with the highest play cost, the Digimon that previously had the highest play cost will now be affected by this effect and can no longer suspend.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent only has 1 play cost 5 Digimon. If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect, then an opponent's play cost 6 Digimon is played, can their other Digimon with a play cost of 5 suspend?

Card Q&A.a: No, it can't suspend. This effect prevents all of your opponent's Digimon from suspending, except their highest play cost Digimon. If a Digimon is later played and becomes the one with the highest play cost, the Digimon that previously had the highest play cost will now be affected by this effect and can no longer suspend.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has 2 play cost 5 Digimon. If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect, then 1 of my opponent's Digimon digivolves into a play cost 6 Digimon, can their other Digimon with a play cost of 5 suspend?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can suspend. Your opponent's Digimon with the highest play cost isn't affected by this effect. If a Digimon with a lower play cost later becomes the one with the highest play cost, it will no longer be affected by this effect, and it can now suspend.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has 1 play cost 5 Digimon and 1 play cost 6 Digimon. If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect, then my opponent's play cost 6 Digimon is removed from the battle area, can their other Digimon with a play cost of 5 suspend?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, they can suspend. If your opponent's Digimon don't have play costs, none of their Digimon can be affected by this effect.
Card Q&A.q: There are only opponent's Digimon with no play costs. If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect, can my opponent's Digimon suspend?

Card Q&A.a: No, they can't suspend. This effect prevents all of your opponent's Digimon other than their highest play cost Digimon from suspending. If a Digimon with a play cost can later be referenced, the Digimon without play costs will now be affected by this effect and can no longer suspend.
Card Q&A.q: There are only opponent's Digimon with no play costs. If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect, then an opponent's Digimon with a play cost is played, can their Digimon without a play cost suspend?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] You may link 1 Digimon card with the [Appmon] trait from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, by unsuspending it, other than their highest play cost Digimon, none of your opponent's Digimon can suspend until their turn ends.
Special Digivolution Condition: If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.
